Bosun Gannet is a human who serves food and drinks in the Blushing Mermaid tavern in Lower City of Baldur's Gate.
“
If yer here to complain' that the booze tastes like piss - I know. Anything else?
„
— Bosun Gannet

Involvement

He is obviously a former sailor (probably a pirate) and partook in erstwhile crew of tavern's owner, Captain Grisly. Bosun Gannet also acts as a trader, selling various types of food and wine, and Supply Packs.

Act Three

Bosun Gannet can be found at the bar counter inside the Blushing Mermaid at X: -145 Y: -100. He is one of the characters who advance ⁠Save Vanra quest, which is the logical follow-up for the ⁠Avenge the Hag Survivors quest. Though Gannet can advance the quest, it is recommended to speak to  Lora Bergauz.

When the story about the kidnapped child is revealed, the party can speak to Gannet to dig out some details. Bosun tells the party that they are not the first ones who ask about the lost kid, little  Vanra Bergauz. The first one was the girl's mother, Lora, who may be found later at the Basilisk Gate Barracks hassling the Flaming Fist in charge. Gannet also tells the party that Lora had been making a real racket about her missing daughter and eventually was thrown out of the tavern by its owner, Captain Grisly.

As the quest continues, Bosun Gannet remembers some things about what had been really happening in the tavern, after false  Captain Grisly has begun to run the show there. The first point when he might be approached about the details is after true identity of 'Grisly' has been revealed, and the party defeated the Tipplesome Patrons inside the tavern (Bosun himself and other tavern patrons do not take part in the battle until attacked or unintentionally damaged, e.g. by an AOE spell). However, he is obviously suffering from a memory-tampering charm and after spilling out a piece of secret 'changes his mind' and tries to convince the party that nothing unusual is happening around.

After Auntie Ethel in her hag form has been defeated, Gannet's reactions differ depending on whether real Captain Grisly survived or died.

If Captain Grisly survives, Bosun tells the party that he regrets not being able to help and protect her, because all that had been happening was like being stuck in a fog. He also welcomes the party 'aboard', saying that they are part of Mermaid's crew now.

If Captain Grisly is killed when clearing The Blushing Mermaid - Basement, Gannet nonetheless does not put the blame on the party. He is aware of the hag who had been nesting in the tavern, and sincerely mourns the death of his former captain. He tells the party that he is running the tavern from now on, and he welcomes the party there any time.

Whatever has happened to Grisly, if extending sympathy to her fate, Bosun Gannet becomes their ally and henceforth is outlined in green. However, if using only the 'trade' line after the quest has been finished, the bartender remains neutral to the party.

After speaking with the party about the outcome of ⁠Save Vanra, the only possible interaction with Gannet is trading.
